notes:
High-level: Saffron builds an in-product support assistant for mid-enterprise SaaS customers. Primary goal is ticket deflection and faster agent triage. Wants RAG-style search where retrieval + rerank returns reliable top-5 candidates in front of lightweight generation or UI snippets. CTO quote: "If the top-5 aren't right we lose trust — need >95% top-5 precision on common intents."

From calls: fragments, priorities and constraints:
- Wants hybrid approach: offline dense embeddings for historical tickets + live embeddings for KB updates.
- Current corpus: ~3M support tickets, 500k KB articles, expected growth to ~20-30M docs in 12 months.
- Latency SLO: target P95 end-to-end for retrieval+rerank <= 150ms (strict for conversational deflection flow).
- Cost target: <$0.008 per user query for retrieval + rerank (excluding generation), very cost-sensitive at scale.
- Reranker model: prefer a lightweight cross-encoder to rerank top-100 -> top-5, but open to Redwood suggestions (quantized variants or model distillation).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, and EU data residency for some customers.
- Integrations: Zendesk + in-house ticketing; wants streaming snippets to populate UI cards; fallback to full generation only when confidence low.
- Quote from Head of CS: "We need predictable token costs and per-route dashboards — cannot blindside ops."
summary_requirements: Ticket-deflection RAG: embeddings + ANN retrieval, cross-encoder reranking for top-5 quality, tight P95 latency budget, EU residency for subsets, must integrate with Zendesk and internal routing
technical_constraints: Index scale: initially 3M docs, plan 20-30M. Expect many short docs (tickets) with an average of 120 tokens. Need memory/disk tradeoffs for vector store; propose optional Dedicated cluster. Must support incremental indexing and zero-downtime rollouts.
rerank_targets: Quality: top-5 precision >= 95% on high-frequency intents; prefer F1/precision snapshots per intent. Rerank latency budget: <= 60ms p95 for cross-encoder on top-100 candidates (prefer quantized GPU path).
perf_targets: Retrieval + Rerank end-to-end p95 <= 150ms; Retrieval p95 <= 40ms; ANN recall@100 >= 98% for core intents. P50 targets much lower (sub-40ms).
cost_targets: Target per-query cost for retrieval+rerank <$0.008; overall platform target <$0.02 including optional small generation for high-confidence snippets.
index_scale_estimate: Phase 1: 3M docs (PoC). Phase 2: 12M docs in 6 months. Phase 3: 20-30M docs in 12 months. Expect 2-4x daily new ticket ingestion during spikes.
poC_scope: 2-week POC: ingest 30k canonical tickets + 100k KB snippets, evaluate vector store options (hosted vs dedicated), run retrieval+rerank perf matrix across sequence lengths, measure p95 and cost per query. Deliverables: perf dashboard, cost analysis, recommended config for Dedicated pool if needed.
current_stack_notes: Currently using Elastic + custom dense embeddings (on-prem GPU hosts) for search; they see high variance in latency and cost. Evaluating Redwood to standardize serving and reduce token costs. Mentioned Pinecone used for a small proof-of-concept last year.
win_criteria:
- Meet latency SLOs in production-like environment
- Demonstrate top-5 quality >=95% on supplied eval set
- Show cost delta vs current (>=20% reduction) or justify Dedicated pricing via predictable throughput
- Security sign-off for VPC/KMS/EU residency
objections_and_risks: Legal needs detailed data residency flow; procurement asks for SOC2 + encryption attestation; performance risk on reranker at 20M+ index size if done on CPU-only nodes. SE notes: need to test quantized cross-encoder on A100/T4 mix.
recommended_next_steps: 1) Lock POC statement of work and get purchase order for 2-week trial (AE). 2) SE to provision sandbox dedicated cluster for rerank experiments. 3) Security to run short questionnaire and provide KMS integration doc (link above).
